description: Revert to the most stable and historically best-performing configuration (8 layers, 128 head dim, 128 batch size, 0.06 Matrix LR) with 0% warmup, as recent runs consistently achieved ~0.9882-0.9885, approaching the record 0.9881, indicating this aggressive setting is the optimal path without the instability of higher LRs or the suboptimal convergence of lower LRs.
